metadata.name: MTA Bus Route Segment Speeds: 2023 - 2024
metadata.description: This dataset provides data on how fast buses are traveling between pairs of subsequent timepoints (the major stops on a bus route) for every bus route in the system. It will provide the average speed in miles per hour between pairs of timepoints, the average travel time in minutes, the road distance in miles, and the number of bus trips for each bus route aggregated by month, day of the week, and hour of day. It also provides the type of bus trip (Local, Limited, SBS, Express, School), the borough of the bus route, the names of the timepoints, their coordinates, and the stop sequence order of the first two timepoints in a pair.

columns.name: Year
columns.description: The year for the data.

columns.name: Month
columns.description: The month bus speeds are being aggregated to.

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the year, month, hour of week the data represents in a MM/DD/YYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM format.

columns.name: Day of Week
columns.description: The day of the week bus speeds are being aggregated to.

columns.name: Hour of Day
columns.description: The hour the data is being aggregated to (0 to 23).

columns.name: Route ID
columns.description: The individual bus route.

columns.name: Direction
columns.description: The direction of service (N, S, E, W).

columns.name: Borough
columns.description: The borough of which the bus route services.

columns.name: Route Type

columns.name: Stop Order
columns.description: The stop sequence order of the first timepoint of the pair.

columns.name: Timepoint Stop ID

columns.name: Timepoint Stop Name
columns.description: The name of the first of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Timepoint Stop Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the first of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Timepoint Stop Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the first of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Next Timepoint Stop ID
columns.description: The stop id of the second of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Next Timepoint Stop Name
columns.description: The name of the second of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Next Timepoint Stop Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the second of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Next Timepoint Stop Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the second of a pair of timepoint bus stops bus speeds are being measured between.

columns.name: Road Distance
columns.description: The roadway distance in miles between the pair of timepoint bus stops.

columns.name: Average Travel Time
columns.description: The average travel time in minutes for all bus trips on a bus route between the pair of subsequent timepoint bus stops for a particular hour of day, day of week, and month.

columns.name: Average Road Speed
columns.description: The average speed in miles per hour for all bus trips on a bus route between the pair of subsequent timepoint bus stops for a particular hour of day, day of week, and month.

columns.name: Bus Trip Count
columns.description: The number of bus trips on the specific bus route between the pair of subsequent timepoint bus stops for a particular hour of day, day of week, and month.

columns.name: Timepoint Stop Georeference
columns.description: Open Data platform-generated geocoding information from supplied coordinates or address components. Point-type location is the centroid of the address components provided and does not reflect a specific point unless coordinates or the street address component are provided. Point-type location is supplied in "POINT ( )" format.
